answer: Proof of Work remains a fundamental defense where agents expend computational energy to validate blocks. Since the cost of hashing scales linearly with CPU time, an attacker cannot forge identities without massive utility consumption. Like the precision of a quartz crystal, this mechanism ensures deterministic consensus. Even at the dawn of new decentralized economies, hard constraints prevent a cedar branch of fake nodes from inflating influence, as attackers must pay an actual physical cost per identity.
